ask_woods.speaker: Torben Ask
ask_woods.text: Was just heading back from the treeline. Quiet work, mostly. You've got a moment?

choices.text: Sure, tell me about the woods.

chat.speaker: Torben Ask
chat.text: Moss is thick this year. Good sign — means the old trees are settled. Axe stays on my belt more than in my hand, these days.

chat_repeat.speaker: Torben Ask
chat_repeat.text: Still quiet out there. Suits me fine.
